crossRefs.note: For the Father has affection for the Son, and shows him all things that he himself does. He will show him greater works…
For the Father judges no one, but he has given all judgment to the Son,
Even as the Father has loved me, I also have loved you. Remain in my love.
I in them, and you in me, that they may be perfected into one; that the world may know that you sent me and loved them…
I made known to them your name, and will make it known; that the love with which you loved me may be in them, and I in…
then I was the craftsman by his side. I was a delight day by day, always rejoicing before him,
“Behold, my servant, whom I uphold, my chosen, in whom my soul delights: I have put my Spirit on him. He will bring…
Behold, a voice out of the heavens said, “This is my beloved Son, with whom I am well pleased.”
While he was still speaking, behold, a bright cloud overshadowed them. Behold, a voice came out of the cloud, saying…
Jesus, knowing that the Father had given all things into his hands, and that he came from God, and was going to God,
even as you gave him authority over all flesh, so he will give eternal life to all whom you have given him.
Pharaoh said to Joseph, “I am Pharaoh. Without you, no man shall lift up his hand or his foot in all the land of Egypt.”
When all the land of Egypt was famished, the people cried to Pharaoh for bread, and Pharaoh said to all the Egyptians…
Ask of me, and I will give the nations for your inheritance, the uttermost parts of the earth for your possession.
For a child is born to us. A son is given to us; and the government will be on his shoulders. His name will be called…
Of the increase of his government and of peace there shall be no end, on David’s throne, and on his kingdom, to…
All things have been delivered to me by my Father. No one knows the Son, except the Father; neither does anyone know…
Jesus came to them and spoke to them, saying, “All authority has been given to me in heaven and on earth.
Turning to the disciples, he said, “All things have been delivered to me by my Father. No one knows who the Son is…
For, “He put all things in subjection under his feet.” But when he says, “All things are put in subjection”, it is…
He put all things in subjection under his feet, and gave him to be head over all things for the assembly,
Therefore God also highly exalted him, and gave to him the name which is above every name,
has at the end of these days spoken to us by his Son, whom he appointed heir of all things, through whom also he made…
You have put all things in subjection under his feet.” For in that he subjected all things to him, he left nothing that…
But we see him who has been made a little lower than the angels, Jesus, because of the suffering of death crowned with…
who is at the right hand of God, having gone into heaven, angels and authorities and powers being made subject to him.

translations.web: The Father loves the Son, and has given all things into his hand.
translations.bsb: The Father loves the Son and has placed all things in His hands.
translations.kjv: The Father loveth the Son, and hath given all things into his hand.
translations.asv: The Father loveth the Son, and hath given all things into his hand.
